brief: Identify principal, interest and fees in a fictional loan agreement.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Parts of a loan"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Partes del préstamo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Partes do empréstimo"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify principal, interest and fees in a fictional loan agreement.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Identify what you borrowed and what you are charged for borrowing it.
instruction.misconception: Principal, interest and administrative fees are all interchangeable names for the borrowed cash.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: Borrowed money is principal. Interest charges for using it; a separately listed processing fee is another charge.
Principal is the money borrowed, not the borrowing charges.
Interest is charged for using the borrowed money.
The agreement explicitly separates processing fees from interest.
Waiving interest does not waive the separately stated fee.
Principal repayment and interest charges serve different purposes.
Withholding a fee does not itself repay borrowed principal.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
